meta.name: appinsights-instrumentation
meta.description: Guidance for instrumenting webapps with Azure Application Insights. Provides telemetry patterns, SDK setup, and configuration references. WHEN: how to instrument app, App Insights SDK, telemetry patterns, what is App Insights, Application Insights guidance, instrumentation examples, APM best practices.

copy.tagline: 给网页应用加上运行追踪,看清报错和性能数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在开发网页应用,想了解用户行为和程序报错。
copy.tagline_en: Add runtime monitoring to web apps to surface errors and performance data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web apps and want visibility into usage and errors.

howto.what: Claude 会先确认你的 Web 应用类型与托管位置，再给出 Azure Application Insights 的接入指引：能自动插桩就引导自动，否则给出手动创建资源与修改代码的步骤，并提供 SDK 快速参考。它只提供指导，不直接改动项目。
howto.when: 当你询问如何为 Web 应用接入 Azure Application Insights、想了解 App Insights 概念或 SDK 用法时触发；工作区应用需为托管在 Azure 的 ASP.NET Core 或 Node.js 应用。

say.text: 这个 Node.js 应用能自动插桩吗？
App Insights 和 OpenTelemetry 怎么配合用？
say.note: Claude 会给出对应 SDK 的快速参考。

howto.what_en: Claude first checks your web app's language/framework and hosting, then guides App Insights setup: auto-instrument when possible, otherwise manual steps to create a resource and change code—or offers SDK references. It only advises, never edits the project.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask how to instrument a web app with Azure Application Insights, need SDK setup instructions or telemetry patterns. Workspace app must be an ASP.NET Core or Node.js app hosted in Azure.

say_en.text: How can I instrument my ASP.NET Core app with Application Insights?
say_en.note: Claude will ask about hosting and provide matching steps.

say_en.text: Can this Node.js app use auto-instrumentation?
say_en.note: If hosted in Azure App Service, Claude follows the auto guide.

say_en.text: How does App Insights work with OpenTelemetry?
say_en.note: Claude gives the relevant SDK quick reference.
